notes: Recorded 86 master's rows and 67 doctoral rows: every major in the four official 2027 catalogues (English-taught master's 59 entries, Chinese-taught master's 57, English-taught doctoral 55, Chinese-taught doctoral 51). A major listed in both the English and the Chinese catalogue for the same school is one row that says so; the same major at different schools is a separate row. The catalogues state no totals of their own.
Master's catalogue rows carry the research fields as written in the catalogue; doctoral catalogues give no research fields.

The master's and doctoral tuition shown is the catalogue's tuition without a waiver; some programmes (MBA, Master of Finance, Technology Transfer, programmes with overseas partners) have totals or partner-institution fees.

The guide says the School of Medicine admits independently (its programmes are not in these catalogues), and School of Medicine appears in the letter-of-intent list; no medical majors could be recorded from the official catalogues.

The Paris Elite Institute of Technology master's programmes are the French-taught programmes; the Japanese and German language and literature tracks under Foreign Languages and Literatures are named as research fields.
Catalogue year is 2027 intake (published November 2026). Names keep the catalogue's English wording, including its spelling (for example Molecule Biology).
